title: Beast Games vs Kardashians
description: A vertically split composite image. The left side displays stylized golden Art Nouveau patterns with floating celebrity faces against a green and red background, featuring 'Beast Games' at the top, a glowing 'Shop' NFL logo, and 'American Horror Story' at the bottom. The right side shows a cinematic staircase scene with a man in a glowing green and red superhero-style costume standing above a woman in a dramatic black gown, with a 'YouTube Originals' 'Kardashians' billboard and green laser lights visible.
